{{Quote|The symbols on the Deejo tablets call the creator of the Slave Pits 'habensa'&mdash;which in modern Argazdan means 'one who builds', and is considered synonymous with the Basic word architect. Three thousand years ago, however, the term would have had an entirely different meaning: 'one who sculpts, or more specifically 'one who shapes'.|Author Dr. [[Heilan Rotham]]|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
'''''Tactile Writings in the Kanz Sector''''' was a thesis published in the historical journal ''[[Historiana Galactica Quarterly]]''. It was written by Dr. [[Heilan Rotham]]. Among its topics were the origins of the [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]] and their mysterious [[Unidentified female Yuuzhan Vong Shaper|alien creator]], who was known as [[habensa]] in the [[Argazdan (language)|Argazdan]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] cited it in an [[Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd|essay]] she wrote about a visit she made to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].
